value.rationale: This is a motivated sharp boundary for a natural stochastic-monotonicity strengthening of an exact conditional mean comparison, not merely another finite coefficient. It establishes an infinite two-parameter noncomparability region and first possible even sample size \(n=8\), demonstrating a genuine rare-tail/mean reversal and a limitation of fixed-point-based distributional ordering.
